title: Donkey Kong Bananza [Switch 2]
description: A destruction-driven 3D action-platformer built for Nintendo Switch 2. Donkey Kong and young Pauline descend through a layered underground world, smashing terrain, collecting Banandium Gems and using Bananza transformations.

gameplayPillars.title: Break almost everything
gameplayPillars.description: Punch through walls, tunnel downward and tear chunks of terrain free to use as weapons or traversal tools.

gameplayPillars.title: Transform with Bananza
gameplayPillars.description: Pauline's songs unlock powerful forms including Kong, Zebra and Ostrich Bananza.

gameplayPillars.title: Explore every layer
gameplayPillars.description: Each underground layer hides Banandium Gems, fossils, challenges, characters and alternate routes.

worldSummary: The Underground World is divided into distinct layers ranging from canyons and forests to frozen regions, resorts and dangerous industrial areas. DK and Pauline descend toward the Planet Core while Void Company races to claim its wish-granting power.

storyChapters.title: The descent begins
storyChapters.body: DK and Pauline enter the Underground World and begin moving toward the Planet Core.

storyChapters.title: Void Company
storyChapters.body: Void Kong and his company race the heroes through the layers in pursuit of the Core's power.

storyChapters.title: Planet Core
storyChapters.body: The adventure culminates deep below the surface where the conflict over the world's greatest treasure is resolved.

faq.a: The base game supports 1–2 players on one system; the second player controls Pauline.
DK Island & Emerald Rush adds DK Island, character interactions, statues, bonus stages and the repeatable Emerald Rush challenge mode.
Nintendo lists 9 GB for the base game; the DLC is approximately 919 MB.

verdictSummary: One of Nintendo's strongest modern 3D platformers, built around an unusually tactile destruction system and constant discovery. Its combination of movement, smashing, transformations and layered exploration gives Donkey Kong a distinct 3D identity.
